description: A compatibility adapter that lets Self-EvolveRec diagnose trained recommendation models while preserving the RecHarness benchmark protocol. DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returns metrics and metric_definitions.
motivation: Keep diagnostics compatible with architecture changes, grounded in available public data, and aligned with the shared validation objective.
implementation_notes: Retain the required class and method signatures. Access the actual trained module through view.model and adapt probes to its architecture. Preserve the view interfaces item_emb, log2feats, predict_score, user_train, meta_data, and review_data without fabricating unavailable data. Batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B x L. Only interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps are available; review content, ratings, item attributes beyond those fields, and simulator diversity/conformity traits are unavailable. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Preserve all four dataset routes and select models using macro-average validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    initialize(view, device)
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        access trained model through view.model
        inspect batches using architecture-compatible probes
        compute only diagnostics supported by observed data
        record definitions and unavailable diagnostics explicitly
        return metrics, metric_definitions

For simulator input:
    for each of four categories:
        generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations
        for five designated real training users

For model selection:
    use the pinned evaluator's macro validation HR@10

originality.positive: Provides a concrete bridge between native diagnostics and a controlled recommendation benchmark.
originality.negative: Defines an integration contract rather than a new recommendation algorithm.

future_potential.positive: Can support architecture changes and comparable, evidence-grounded diagnostic feedback.
future_potential.negative: Its value depends on probe quality; unavailable traits cannot be directly diagnosed.

code_difficulty.positive: Explicit interfaces and batch shapes make the adapter straightforward to structure.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture-specific probes and compatibility views require careful validation.
